problem.title: Escape the Spreading Fire
problem.problemStatement: You are given an m × n grid containing: 0 for empty land 1 for fire 2 for walls You start at the top-left cell and want to reach the bottom-right cell. Each minute: You may move to an adjacent empty cell. Fire simultaneously spreads to adjacent non-wall cells. Determine the maximum number of minutes you can wait before starting your journey while still being able to safely reach the destination. Return -1 if reaching the destination is impossible.
problem.input: Integers m and n An m × n grid
